_comment: Per-month DataForSEO spend plan for the SEO/GEO POC. Front-loaded on purpose: month 1 buys a dense baseline so impact is visible fast, then measurement thins as trend lines establish. Jobs read the tier matching the current month and must not exceed monthly_ceiling_usd. NOTE: content drafting costs $0 here -- GSC reads, the blog API, and Claude Code's own drafting all sit outside DataForSEO. Everything below is MEASUREMENT spend only, so content output volume is bounded by human review capacity, not by this budget.
_prices_source: MEASURED against this account on 2026-08-25 with production config (max_output_tokens 4096, web_search on), not estimated. Raw DataForSEO prices -- self-hosted OpenSEO pays DataForSEO directly, so OpenSEO's 1.28x hosted credit markup does not apply.
_price_notes: serp_queued_depth40 = 0.0006 base page + 3 x 0.00045 extra pages, from the account price table + OpenSEO's own formula. Not yet independently measured.

Perplexity is 2.4x cheaper than Gemini and sends almost no input tokens (22 vs 530-11007) because it does its own retrieval. Best cost lever if a month needs trimming: swap gemini -> perplexity in the 2-model config, saving ~32% of GEO spend.

Gemini is the most expensive model despite low per-token rates -- it emitted 2075 output tokens vs Claude's 857. Cost here is driven by output length and web-search input bloat, not headline token price.

Coverage beats frequency for a POC: 130 keywords at 3x weekly ($3.30) costs LESS than 66 keywords daily ($3.86) and covers 2x the surface. Daily SERP checks mostly sample day-to-day ranking noise; the extra keywords are real additional signal.

months.goal: Dense baseline + make impact visible inside 30 days. GEO runs the same chat_gpt+gemini pair every week, so week-1 vs week-4 is like-for-like. Rank tracking runs daily this month only, to establish the baseline at maximum resolution.

geo_prompts.schedule: all 20 prompts x 2 models (chat_gpt + gemini), weekly
geo_prompts._note: 2-model config chosen up front, so every run in every month is directly comparable -- no methodology change between the first and last measurement of the POC.

months.goal: Keep weekly resolution; drop rank tracking off daily now the baseline exists.

geo_prompts.schedule: all 20 prompts x 2 models (chat_gpt + gemini), weekly

months.goal: Steady state. Swap gemini -> perplexity to hold 2-model coverage at 32% lower cost.

geo_prompts.schedule: all 20 prompts x 2 models (chat_gpt + perplexity), weekly

months.goal: Maintenance. Enough signal to catch a regression, not to explore.

geo_prompts.schedule: tier=weekly prompts only (10) x 2 models (chat_gpt + perplexity), every other week
